messages:
Asha (PM): quick sync — I need input on a phased gates proposal for model onboarding + deprecation comms. goal: reduce surprise for customers while keeping onboarding throughput. TL;DR below.
Sam (Eng): sounds good, paste TL;DR and we can flag technical blockers.
Asha (PM): plan idea: 3 gates — (1) entry gate: perf & safety smoke + infra footprint estimate, (2) ramp gate: 1 week canary + benchmark windows, (3) sunset gate: deprecation notice + migration assist. customers get explicit pin options per gate.
Diego (Product Ops): +1 for explicit windows. ask: how do we measure "canary success"? latency p50/p95, token cost delta, and a small eval prompt set?
Sam (Eng): yep. propose thresholds: p95 latency <= current model p95 * 1.15, cost delta <= 20% for same QoS, and no more than 5% regression on eval prompts. we can automate alerts.
Nina (SRE): need to add infra signal: tail GPU mem + queue depth. canary should run against dedicated pool to avoid noisy neighbors. also need rollback hooks in the serving layer.
Riley (Sales AE): customers will push back on a 20% cost delta. can we offer a temporary grace (discount or pin) while they evaluate before full migration? some enterprise deals require a formal opt-in window.
Asha (PM): good call. propose a 30-day pin opt-in after canary pass — customers can stay on old model for up to 30 days with telemetry flagged. after that, auto-roll to new model unless they request extension. add an exceptions flow for compliance-heavy accounts.
Diego (Product Ops): one more: comm cadence. send notice at gate entry (pre-canary), canary start update, canary results + migration playbook, then deprecation 30/14/7/1 days. include SRE runbook link and rollback contact. ops-bot: scheduled reminder templates?
ops-bot: Reminder templates created: /templates/model-migration-notice.md and /templates/canary-results-summary.md — use these for comms. :white_check_mark:
Riley (Sales AE): templates are great. ask: can we include a simple cost comparison calc per customer (tokens, typical seq len)? helps us negotiate credits.
Sam (Eng): we can export per-tenant token histograms from usage pipeline and run a projection job. engineering estimate: add a weekly job that produces CSVs. need Product to prioritize the feature.
Asha (PM): prioritizing — I'll add the per-tenant cost projection to the roadmap as a P1 for migrations. Diego, can you own comm templates + launch checklist? Sam, Nina — can you own canary automation and rollback hooks? Riley — coordinate with top 5 accounts and collect policy exceptions.
Diego (Product Ops): on it. I'll draft the checklist this week and post a short PR for feedback.
Sam (Eng): we'll prototype canary automation next sprint. question: do we want to allow partial routing (e.g., 10% traffic) during ramp gate? that's operationally heavier but safer.
Nina (SRE): partial routing yes, but requires route-based observability. we have tracing hooks but need a routing flag in the control plane. estimate 2 sprints to land safely.
Asha (PM): ok let's make partial routing an aspirational capability for Q2; for initial rollouts we'll use dedicated canary pools with 100% of selected customer traffic. document decision in the checklist.
Riley (Sales AE): any guidance on customer-facing language? customers hate the word "deprecation." recommend "model upgrade window" and emphasize migration assist + pin option.
Diego (Product Ops): agreed — use "upgrade" in external comms, keep "deprecation" internal. I'll update templates.
Asha (PM): outstanding risks: (1) big customers request indefinite pins — need commercial/legal escalation, (2) cost regressions > threshold, (3) automation lag for rollback. mitigation: escalation path, pre-negotiated credits, and SRE runbook drills.
Sam (Eng): note: quantized variants may be available — we should allow model variant mapping as fallback (higher latency, lower cost). need to enumerate compatible variants in the catalog metadata.
Diego (Product Ops): add metadata field: compatible_variants and fallback_policy. I'll add to the onboarding checklist schema.
Asha (PM): action items: Diego drafts checklist + templates by EOD Fri; Sam & Nina spike canary automation estimate by Tue; Riley lists top 5 customers and their contract constraints by Wed; I'll write PRD with gates + thresholds and link it to roadmap card.
Riley (Sales AE): got it. quick question — for customers requesting longer pins, what's the default negotiation policy?
Asha (PM): default: allow one 30-day extension for free (ops + analytics flagged), thereafter escalates to commercial for credits/terms. put that in PRD.
Diego (Product Ops): will do. I'll post the first draft in #product-docs and tag everyone. :eyes:
Sam (Eng): FYI — we'll need time to test rollback under load, can we schedule a 2-hour chaos window with infra next week?
Nina (SRE): I'll carve out a window and book infra ops.
Asha (PM): perfect. thanks team — I'll close the loop after drafts are in. :sparkles:
